notes.title: New difficulty!
notes.content:
Hi competitors!

Today I'm adding a new difficulty option to the game: Brutal. On Brutal difficulty:
[list]
[*] Enemy AI will tend to make more optimal decisions than on easier difficulty settings
[*] All parts will award the player 10% less health than they normally would
[/list]
I've also added some new achievements related to this mode, and a helpful tooltip to the game setup screens to help you know what the differences between each difficulty are.

Good luck and enjoy!

notes.title: 11-20-2022 Update
notes.content:
Hi all, rolling out an update today to introduce custom rules to Arena Mode!

With custom rules, you can tweak things like what monsters you and your opponent can fight with, how strong the type system is, how many battles you want to fight, and more! Also note that [b]achievements will be disabled while using custom rules[/b], so no giving yourself $100k to play one battle and get a permadeath achievement ;) Check it out and please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or run into any issues.

There's also two small patches included in this build:
[list]
[*] Enemies can now access boss parts as they are unlocked, the same as the player
[*] A notification will now appear on the main menu if the game can't connect to Steam
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42782991/55fac9c14c70d152a5ff7c14ccbdf8e3eaa74132.png[/img]
